description: The .beads/embeddeddolt database is currently inside Dropbox (cloud-synced filesystem), which is the documented trigger for beads disk I/O error 522. Options: (1) move .beads/ outside Dropbox using BEADS_DIR env var, (2) configure a Dolt remote as the persistence layer so local state is less critical, (3) confirm Dropbox selective-sync excludes .beads/ from active sync. Resolve before adding significant task history here.
